verdict.rationale: Carta is an equity-management and fund-data SaaS, which could plausibly offer scheduled reports or recurring workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only on-demand API reads, draft creation, a data warehouse for SQL queries, and MCP plugins for natural-language queries. Nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows; one-off API calls and queries are not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
